text: きょうは　おにいさん　ポケモンの　つかまえかたを　おしえて　あげちゃうぞ！

structure.jp: ポケモンの　つかまえかたを
おしえて　あげちゃうぞ！
structure.en: am going to go ahead and teach you!

patterns.name: 〜てあげる
patterns.span: おしえて　あげちゃう
patterns.explanation: てあげる after a verb says you do it as a favour for someone. おしえて　あげちゃう = 'I'll teach you, as a treat'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: あげちゃう is the casual short form of あげてしまう. Here it has no regret in it; it gives a playful feeling of going right ahead. おしえて　あげちゃう = 'I'll go right ahead and teach you'.

patterns.name: 〜かた
patterns.explanation: かた stuck onto a verb stem means 'the way of doing' it. つかまえかた = 'how to catch'.
